```{r}
# run_DIpreprocess standardizes metadata column names (Group, Sample, Batch, InjectionSequence)
std <- function(std_nm, user_nm) if (std_nm %in% names(di$metadata)) std_nm else user_nm
g   <- std("Group", ds$group_col)
qc  <- ds$qc_types
sid <- std("Sample", ds$sample_id_col)
groups <- setdiff(unique(as.character(di$metadata[[g]])), qc)
multi  <- length(groups) > 2  # >2 groups: PLS-DA overall, pairwise ROC
out <- file.path(out_dir, nm); dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## OPLS-DA (PLS-DA fallback)

QC samples are dropped by `run_pls()` automatically for `run_DIpreprocess`
input. With two groups OPLS-DA is tried first and PLS-DA is the fallback; with
more than two groups only PLS-DA is used.

```{r}
fit_pls <- function(method) tryCatch(
  suppressWarnings(run_pls(di, group = g, method = method, verbose = FALSE)),
  error = function(e) e)
pls <- if (multi) fit_pls("plsda") else fit_pls("oplsda")
if (!multi && !is_valid_pls(pls)) {
  cat("OPLS-DA produced no usable model",
      if (inherits(pls, "error")) paste0("(", conditionMessage(pls), ")"),
      "- falling back to PLS-DA.

")
  pls <- fit_pls("plsda")
}
if (is_valid_pls(pls)) {
  plot_score(pls, color_by = g, points_from = sid)
} else {
  cat("PLS-DA also produced no usable model - skipped.")
  pls <- NULL
}
```

## Differential analysis

### Fold change

```{r}
fc <- run_foldchange(di, from = "normalized", up = ds$fc_up, down = ds$fc_down)
as_gt(head(fc$summary_table, 20))
```

### t-test / ANOVA

`run_diff()` selects the test automatically (t-test / Wilcoxon for 2 groups,
ANOVA / Kruskal-Wallis for more) and adjusts p-values across features.

```{r}
dif <- tryCatch(run_diff(di, outcome = colnames(di$data_nonpls), summary_table = TRUE),
                error = function(e) e)
if (inherits(dif, "error")) {
  cat("run_diff failed:", conditionMessage(dif)); dif <- NULL
} else as_gt(dif$summary_table)
```

### Volcano plot

```{r}
vdat <- if (!is.null(dif)) get_volcanodata(fc, dif) else NULL
# Without run_diff results plot_volcano() returns a mean abundance plot instead
vol <- plot_volcano(if (is.null(dif)) list(fc) else list(fc, dif), y = "fold_change",
                    z = if (!is.null(dif) && "p_value_adj" %in% names(dif$summary_table)) "p_value_adj" else "p_value")
invisible(lapply(vol$plots, print))
if (is.null(vdat) || nrow(vdat) == 0) {
  cat("

No features passed the fold change and p-value thresholds;",
      "showing mean abundance per group instead.

")
  keep <- !di$metadata[[g]] %in% qc
  print(plot_meanmap(di$data_nonpls[keep, , drop = FALSE],
                     metadata = di$metadata[keep, , drop = FALSE], group = g))
} else {
  as_gt(vdat)
}
```

## ROC analysis

Uses, when available, the VIP scores (PLS-DA/OPLS-DA), fold change and
t-test/ANOVA results to select candidate features (thresholds: VIP, `up`/`down`,
`p_value` defaults of `run_auc()`). With more than two groups, ROC is run for
every pair of groups, each with its own pairwise PLS-DA, fold change and test.

```{r}
#| results: asis
pairs <- if (multi) combn(groups, 2, simplify = FALSE) else list(groups)

roc_pair <- function(pr) {
  if (!multi) {
    inputs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(di, pls, fc, dif))
    return(run_auc(inputs, set_control = ds$control_group, plot = "all"))
  }
  drop <- c(qc, setdiff(groups, pr))
  p_pls <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(run_pls(di, group = g, method = "plsda",
                                              exclude = drop, verbose = FALSE)),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
  p_fc  <- run_foldchange(di, from = "normalized", filter = drop,
                          up = ds$fc_up, down = ds$fc_down)
  p_dif <- tryCatch(run_diff(di, outcome = colnames(di$data_nonpls), filter = drop,
                             summary_table = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  inputs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(di, if (is_valid_pls(p_pls)) p_pls, p_fc, p_dif))
  run_auc(inputs, remove = drop, set_control = pr[1], plot = "all")
}

roc <- lapply(pairs, function(pr) tryCatch(roc_pair(pr), error = function(e) e))
names(roc) <- vapply(pairs, paste, character(1), collapse = " vs ")

for (nm_pair in names(roc)) {
  r <- roc[[nm_pair]]
  cat("

### ", nm_pair, "

", sep = "")
  if (inherits(r, "error")) {
    cat("ROC analysis failed: ", conditionMessage(r), "

", sep = "")
  } else if (is.null(r$auc_table) || nrow(r$auc_table) == 0) {
    cat("No features passed the filtering criteria.

")
  } else {
    cat(knitr::knit_print(as_gt(r$auc_table)), "

")
    invisible(lapply(r$plots, print))
  }
}
```

```{r}
saveRDS(list(preprocess = di, pca = pca, pls = pls, foldchange = fc, diff = dif, roc = roc),
        file.path(out, "results.rds"))
```
